name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Candlestick goes with at least two of Blackwood, Study, and Gardening.
Spanner goes with none of Blackwood, Ravenscroft, or Study.
Gardening goes with exactly two of Blackwood, Conservatory, and Candlestick.
Between Cellar and Conservatory, one goes with Candlestick and the other with Spanner.
Either Cellar goes with Fairfax or Study goes with Bathing.
